correctness.rationale: Taking the ambient Laplacian verifies the four types of cubic generators. Their transverse harmonics are orthogonal both for values and for gradients, and their dimensions add to the full cubic dimension. For fixed transverse order, integration over the section gives the same scalar quadratic form on all transverse harmonics, including transverse dimension two. The metric gives the claimed latitude densities; their beta-moment averages normalize the full Dirichlet energies. I reconstructed the gap polynomials from the coefficients of the normalized density differences using the derivative of a(1−a²)^((d−1)/2), and the endpoint a=1 fixes the integration constant. Q₀₁ and Q₀₂ give exactly the three cutoffs with s₀<t₁<t₂. Q₀₃ and Q₂₃ are positive throughout; Q₁₂ has positive coefficients for d≥11 and negative discriminant at each integer 3≤d≤10. These signs establish the full ordering, the unique bottom branch, and the top direct sum of dimension d at either top crossing. In the thin-cap limit the order-one density has a positive endpoint value, while the order-three density vanishes quadratically. Integrating with the beta weight gives the claimed exponent −2 and coefficient (d+1)²(d+3)/(6(d+2)). Endpoints a=0 and a=1 are excluded from the strict ordering; complexification does not change the spectrum.
correctness.reproduction: python /workspace/reproductions/independent_checks.py 4 derives all six gap polynomials, checks closure of the polynomial coefficient recursion, verifies exact cutoffs and the thin-cap coefficient, and computes the eight low-dimension discriminants. Frozen checker.py was inspected, not executed.
